notes:
Drag your labels into the order you want. Labelled groups in the Bots list were stuck in alphabetical order - grab a label heading and drag it where you want it. Drop one on Unlabelled to send it to the bottom. The arrangement is saved with your account, so it follows you to another PC.
Round two on CPU usage. The five-second refresh was rebuilding the header counts by loading four entire tables and counting the rows, the map table among them - around 20,000 rows and growing. It counts them in the database now, resource totals are summed there too, and the launch check no longer probes the disk once per account every five seconds. About a quarter of the background work it used to do.
No need to relaunch your bots for this one.
